programs.name: Bachelor of Science
programs.notes: Students enrolled in the Unspecified plan may transfer into a named Science major by completing a plan change. It is recommended that this occurs at the end of first year to facilitate tailored enrolment advice and support from the Program Director of your chosen major. Please contact Student Assist to arrange. Students planning on completing a fourth year of study in the Bachelor of Science (Honours) (HSCIE) are required to identify and transfer into their chosen Science major prior to the end of third year. It is recommended this plan change occurs at the end of the first year of the program to ensure that the requirements of the identified major are met in a timely manner. Students enrolled in the Unspecified plan must complete the following courses: SCIE1001; STAT1000; 12 units of Core Selective courses; 18 units of Common Core courses; 48 units of additional courses from the College of Science, of which at least 18 units must be at Level 3; at least 6 units of integrated learning (WIL) courses; and 48 units of elective courses. Electives can be freely chosen by the student from either the list of electives identified in the study plan, the list of suggested electives from the College of Science, or any other course flagged as a university-wide elective. PMRESBSCIE: Students completing the Bachelor of Science / Master of Research packaged pathway (PMRESBSCIE) should follow the standard study plans for their chosen major, with the exception that the Year 2 Common Core must be replaced with SCIE2001 Principles and Practices of Scientific Research 2, and the Year 3 Common Core with SCIE3018 Principles and Practices of Scientific Research 3. An Unspecified plan is not available for this cohort to ensure that entry requirements for the Master of Research are met.
